quarterly_data.signal: Server liquid cooling (annual report): Lingyi bought Readore in January 2026 to enter the North American AI-compute customer's core supply chain; Readore is a core supplier (RVL/AVL) to a leading North American AI-compute customer (not named). Its GB200/GB300 liquid cooling plates, UQD/MQD quick disconnects, inner (tray) manifolds, rack manifolds and PDB heatsinks are products on that customer's core supplier list (NVL72 RVL/AVL), and its GB200/GB300 liquid cooling plates, quick disconnects and manifolds continue to ship. Other server thermal products listed: optical-module cold plates, NPU liquid-cooling assemblies and the Big MAC multi-axis cavity heat-dissipation element (developed in 2024).
